title: Coordinate presentation of projective rational SL representations and restricted one-parameter coactions
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $E,V$ finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces, and fix a basis $b$ of $V$. Use the coordinate group scheme $G=\operatorname{SL}_{\dim E,k}$ of [def-sc-general-linear-group], identified with $\operatorname{SL}(E)$ by any basis of $E$, and let $\rho:G\to\operatorname{GL}_{\dim V,k}$ be a rational representation in the basis $b$. The space of lines in $V$ is the coordinate projective scheme $\mathbf P(\{1,\ldots,\dim V\};k)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] over $k$ [def-pc-scheme], with homogeneous coordinates the linear coordinate forms dual to $b$; its twist $\mathcal O(1)$ [def-pc-projective-space-twist] is the dual tautological line. For a morphism $j$ from a $k$-scheme $Y$ to it, the pulled-back line $L=j^*\mathcal O(1)$, its coordinate sections, the equivariant action with induced dual tautological linearization [def-sfb-group-scheme-linearization] and the vector lifts of $k$-points are those of [def-sfb-projective-representation-linearization] for the index set of $b$; a vector $v$ lifts $j(y)$ when its coordinate vector $(b_i^\vee(v))_i$ does. For a one-parameter subgroup $\lambda:\mathbf G_m\to G$, define its restricted coaction by $b_q\mapsto\sum_i b_i\otimes\rho(\lambda(t))_{iq}$ over $k[t,t^{-1}]$. A vector has a negative occurring weight if it admits a finite weight decomposition $v=\sum_a z_a$, with $z_a\in V_a$ for the recorded weight spaces [lem-sfb-gm-representation-weight-basis], and $z_a\ne0$ for some $a<0$.
